summary: Master the entire contract lifecycle with our comprehensive training course, covering creation, management, and renewal strategies for optimal efficiency.
lede: Contract lifecycle management provides a practical way to control agreements from drafting and approval through execution, monitoring, amendment, closeout, and renewal. It helps clarify deliverables, roles, timelines, payment terms, milestones, changes, and obligations before gaps become larger problems. This course builds the skills to manage approvals, monitor performance, reduce risk, handle changes consistently, and make informed renewal decisions. Through hands-on tools, templates, and realistic scenarios, participants can apply contract lifecycle practices directly to their work and strengthen accountability, visibility, and results.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly manage, create, approve, monitor, or renew contracts.
modules: Contract Review and Red Flag Identification
Managing Variations, Amendments, and Change Requests
Contract Lifecycle Tools and Digital CLM Practices
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of contract terms and be involved in managing or overseeing contracts in their professional roles. No legal background is necessary.
